text: The Russian state owns 73.77% of Aeroflot.

source.name: PJSC Aeroflot Investor Relations: Shareholder Capital
source.quote: The largest stakeholder in PJSC Aeroflot is the Russian Federation, which has a stake of 73.77% in the Company.

additionalSources.name: bne IntelliNews: Russia seeks partial privatisation of state carrier Aeroflot
additionalSources.quote: The state currently owns 73.77% of Aeroflot, while the free float stands at 25.03%.
